text: Software Engineering is an undergraduate major in regular institutions of higher learning in China, belonging to the category of computer science. It lasts for four years and confers a Bachelor of Engineering degree. It is an engineering science that studies large-scale software development methods, tools and management, emphasizing the organization and standardization of the software development process in accordance with engineering principles and methods, and is committed to solving problems such as efficiency, quality and cost in software development. Its main research contents cover the basic theories, knowledge and skills of software engineering and computer science, including the analysis and development of software, as well as the design and development of computer application systems and computer network systems.
